result.summary: The page is largely visually intact: the layout is clean, images load, and the navigation and cards are aligned. The only clear defect is a text rendering glitch in the 'Tokumaru Ramen' title. Light gray secondary text is a possible minor contrast concern. Clipped carousel items and the partially visible card at the bottom were excluded as intentional.

issues.description: The restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' renders with a malformed final character that looks like 'Rameı' (dotless i), so the name appears misspelled.
issues.suggestion: Check the font's glyph support for the 'n' character or the text encoding, and confirm the title string is 'Tokumaru Ramen' in the source data.

issues.description: Secondary gray text (delivery fees, the '(500+)' review count, and the '25–35 min' metadata) is light gray on a white background, which may fall below recommended contrast ratios.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color to meet at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio against white.
